faq.q: What is the stamp duty to buy land in Poonamallee?
faq.a: The stamp duty in Poonamallee is 7% of the market value of the property, paid to the government during the registration process.

faq.q: What is the registration cost for buying land in Poonamallee?
faq.a: The registration fee is 4% of the property's market value, paid in addition to the stamp duty at the time of registration.

faq.q: What things must be considered while selecting a plot in Poonamallee?
faq.a: Check for DTCP or CMDA approval, clear title documents, and availability of basic amenities — and assess the area's connectivity, infrastructure, and future growth prospects.

faq.q: Are the plots near Poonamallee registered under RERA?
faq.a: Not all individual plots are RERA registered, but large residential layouts and projects typically fall under Tamil Nadu RERA. Confirm the RERA status with the developer or the official RERA portal.

faq.q: How can I check the legal status of a residential plot before buying it in Poonamallee?
faq.a: Verify the Encumbrance Certificate, Patta, and CMDA/DTCP approvals. Consulting a qualified property lawyer is also recommended to ensure all documents are in order.
